settings.title: Settings
settings.provider_help: Select the AI engine used for media analysis and tag generation. Ollama is standard for local operation.
settings.language_help: Switch application interface language between Japanese and English.
settings.ffmpeg_notice: Show notice when FFmpeg is not installed
settings.ffmpeg_notice_help: Toggle notice icon when FFmpeg (required for video processing) is missing.
settings.ollama_url_help: Connection URL for running Ollama server instance (default: http://localhost:11434).
settings.vlm_model_help: Vision model responsible for analyzing image content and video frames (e.g. minicpm-v, llama3.2-vision).
settings.force_detailed_help: Forcing detailed mode on smaller models (<8B) may cause parsing errors if the model fails complex JSON formatting. Recommended OFF (auto-falls back to LIGHT mode on failure).
settings.text_model_help: Language model for structured tag extraction & Japanese/English tag translation from VLM output (e.g. qwen2.5, llama3.1).
settings.unload_vram_help: Instantly unloads loaded Ollama models from GPU VRAM. Model will be purged even if used by other WebUI or applications.
settings.ollama_not_installed: Ollama is not installed or service is not running. Please start or install Ollama to use local VLM features.
